desc: A forecourt. A clay calendar stone, a candelabrum, a map and a torch lie here. A stone stele and a stone basin stand here. Ways out: a door north and the way out.

features.name: stone stele
features.note: 38 signs, old style, complete, "in a slanted hand".

name: Temple forecourt
statusNote: Looked until nothing new; stele and basin transcribed. Map, calendar stone, candelabrum and torch left here (pack full).
